features.visitor_job: Choose the right paper for news now, today's changes, the week's bigger picture or opinion and big questions.
features.environment_object: Four distinct physical newspapers on Paige's rack: The Breaking, The Daily, The Weekly and The Tribune.
features.desktop: All four live paper controls are equally legible and operable on Paige's CSS/DOM counter, with masthead, job, state and opening result visible.
features.mobile: The four paper controls form a two-by-two counter rack with all publication jobs and states visible before opening.
features.accessibility: Each paper is a named button with its job, current state and pressed state; the conventional four-publication selector remains an equal fallback.
features.growth_behavior: Publication state, current issue identity and counts are live data on stable paper objects; new issues replace rack inventory without regenerating the stand.
features.new_feature_behavior: A genuinely new publication requires a distinct editorial job, source/state contract and physical rack place; it cannot appear as another generic status button.
features.preview_contract: Before pulling a paper, its masthead, editorial job, dated current/quiet/hold/stale state and the result of opening are visible without hover.
features.opened_experience: Pulling unfolds the chosen paper in place at Paige's counter, preserves rack context and provides a clear Put the paper back action.

features.visitor_job: See the eligible stories in one publication without filler or misleading currentness.
features.environment_object: The selected newspaper unfolded on Paige's counter.
features.desktop: The front page opens in the same counter workspace with edition, date, checked state and eligible story list.
features.mobile: The unfolded paper becomes one readable column while retaining masthead, state, date and return control.
features.accessibility: The selected edition is announced, the reader title receives focus and suppressed states expose a textual reason instead of an empty body.
features.growth_behavior: Each publication front page renders any number of eligible canonical stories; pagination/archive rules handle overflow without changing stand art.
features.new_feature_behavior: New front-page modules require a proven editorial job and enter the unfolded paper, not a detached homepage-style card rail.
features.preview_contract: The rack states what the paper is for and its availability before pull; the front page then lists each story's headline, deck, edition, date and status before article open.
features.opened_experience: The paper is a scrollable front page with conventional story links, truthful empty/error states and one obvious return to the same rack control.

features.visitor_job: Know what a story covers and why it matters before opening the full article.
features.environment_object: A headline, deck and status printed on the unfolded paper's front page.
features.result: The exact story hash rendered inside #ns-paper-view
features.desktop: Each printed front-page story shows edition, published date, headline, deck and access state before opening.
features.mobile: The same information remains visible as a readable news item rather than an image-only cover or tiny hotspot.
features.accessibility: The story link has a complete purpose, hash access is re-evaluated and blocked stories expose a reason without stale body content.
features.growth_behavior: Canonical story records populate the current paper and archive; additional stories use the same headline/deck/status grammar.
features.new_feature_behavior: New story formats declare their preview fields and reader structure before entering the paper; a label alone cannot conceal a different job.
features.preview_contract: Headline, plain-language deck, publication, date, correction/retraction state and the fact that opening enters the full sourced explanation are visible before activation.
features.opened_experience: The article replaces the front-page list within the unfolded paper, keeps the publication context and supports browser/Put the paper back recovery.

features.visitor_job: Understand the event, what LAiDIES makes of it, what it means for the reader and which sources support it.
features.environment_object: The full newspaper article with dated correction notice and source box.
features.desktop: The article reads continuously with story/argument, LAiDIES read, consequence, watch points, sources, dates and tags.
features.mobile: The article uses one continuous readable column; no decorative newspaper page-turn sequence is required.
features.accessibility: Headings structure the article, source links name their publishers and open safely, and correction/retraction state is textual and dated.
features.growth_behavior: Longer stories and new correction entries expand structured article sections and retained history without changing the reader shell.
features.new_feature_behavior: A new explanatory module must improve the publication's job and receive a named section in the continuous article, not an unrelated widget below the stand.
features.preview_contract: The front-page preview identifies the article job and correction/retraction state; source count/type may be summarized without claiming current link health.
features.opened_experience: The article behaves like a good digital newspaper: continuous scroll, clear sections, dated sources/corrections and return to the originating front page—not simulated folding or page turns.

features.visitor_job: Find an older story by headline, topic, source or tag across all four publications.
features.environment_object: The labelled back-issue crate under Paige's counter.
features.result: Eligible search results in #ns-rack inside the same paper workspace
features.desktop: The crate search remains part of the NewsStand counter and opens results in the same paper reader.
features.mobile: Search, result previews and return are one readable flow with query retained through browser history.
features.accessibility: The input has a visible label, Enter and button submit the same action, results/no-result are announced and raw queries are not sent to analytics.
features.growth_behavior: The archive indexes the expanding canonical story array; recent/topic/complete views can be added as crate dividers rather than separate card grids.
features.new_feature_behavior: New discovery modes enter the archive crate only when eligibility, privacy, history and empty/error behavior are defined.
features.preview_contract: Every result shows publication, date, headline, deck and current access/correction state before article open.
features.opened_experience: Opening a result enters the same continuous article reader and Back restores the exact query, result position and focus after rechecking access.

features.visitor_job: Put a paper back or use Back/Forward without losing the selected paper, query, story or safe scroll position.
features.environment_object: The Put the paper back control on the counter and the visitor's browser history.
features.result: The prior rack/search/story view with current eligibility re-evaluated and focus restored
features.desktop: The reader closes back to the invoking paper or archive control and preserves the rack context.
features.mobile: Back/return restores the reachable prior view without horizontal drift or focus loss.
features.accessibility: Focus returns to the invoker or a named safe fallback; restored content is rechecked and unavailable bodies are not resurrected.
features.growth_behavior: Versioned history state carries stable edition, story and query IDs as archive size grows without persisting private reading profiles.
features.new_feature_behavior: Every new reader view must define origin, focus return, state restoration, changed-access behavior and forged-state rejection.
features.preview_contract: The open action makes clear that the story/paper opens in place and can be returned without losing the rack or query.
features.opened_experience: Return is one explicit action; the system restores the previous meaningful state rather than forcing repeated navigation or decorative close steps.

features.visitor_job: Play or pause the optional NewsStand atmosphere without obstructing reading.
features.environment_object: Paige's small radio on the NewsStand counter.
features.desktop: The radio is secondary to publication choice and never auto-plays.
features.mobile: The same conventional play/pause control remains reachable without covering publication or article controls.
features.accessibility: The button exposes play/pause state, audio is user initiated and reading remains complete without sound.
features.growth_behavior: A replacement approved track changes the owner-bound audio record, not the room or publication objects.
features.new_feature_behavior: Additional audio belongs in KSVL unless it has a distinct NewsStand editorial purpose and coexistence contract.
features.preview_contract: The control names the exact optional NewsStand audio and that activation starts sound before playback.
features.opened_experience: Playback stays a simple conventional play/pause state with recoverable error and no visual gimmick replacing publication UX.

current_blockers: Publication authority, immutable source/claim receipts, canonical writer, dated recheck operation, correction lifecycle, public release and rollback remain incomplete.
Native Safari/VoiceOver, real zoom, source-link currentness, privacy-safe analytics and public-origin verification remain open.
